_metadata.description: Static API lifecycle compatibility checks: service metadata, preflight, api-core server use, and health endpoint declarations.

requirements.title: Service manifest declares API health path
requirements.description: The validator checks .vrooli/service.json for an API port, lifecycle health endpoint, and HTTP health check target that can be resolved through Vrooli lifecycle metadata.

validation.notes: Covered by api/internal/validation/lifecycle_test.go and service_test.go. Fixtures cover missing API port, non-/health endpoint metadata, missing lifecycle health check target, and valid config.

requirements.title: API preflight runs before service initialization
requirements.description: The validator proves api/main.go calls api-core/preflight before business logic and with the target scenario name, without depending on scenario-auditor's old line-window heuristics.

validation.notes: Covered by api/internal/validation/lifecycle_test.go and service_test.go. AST fixtures cover wrong ScenarioName, late preflight, harmless log.SetFlags before preflight, and compliant Run/server wiring.

requirements.title: API server uses graceful lifecycle runner
requirements.description: Long-running API services use api-core/server rather than direct http.ListenAndServe or Server.ListenAndServe calls, so shutdown and signal handling stay consistent.

validation.notes: Covered by api/internal/validation/lifecycle_test.go and service_test.go. AST fixtures cover compliant api-core/server.Run and direct http.ListenAndServe findings; broader TLS/test-file fixture expansion remains for the HTTP/runtime phases.
